task_description: Fix slow page load caused by all 1200 image frames (4 sequences x 300 frames = ~184MB) being loaded upfront before showing any content. Implement priority-based lazy loading so only the critical Hero sequences block the preloader, and reduce canvas DPR for better mobile performance.

verification.summary: TypeScript compilation (npx tsc --noEmit) passes with zero errors. Next.js production build (npm run build) succeeds, all routes statically prerendered. No test framework in project so test_quality is skipped.
